title: Exporting for iOS
key_points: This page describes how to export a Godot project to iOS.
To export, open the Export window from the Project menu in Godot editor and select iOS.
You must provide a unique bundle ID for the exported project.
After exporting, you can build and deploy the project directly on an Apple Silicon Mac without iOS simulator limitations.
limitations: Projects written in C# can be exported to iOS as of Godot 4.2, but support is experimental and some limitations apply.
The iOS simulator only supports the Compatibility renderer.
asserts: Godot projects can be exported to Xcode for building and deploying on iOS devices or submitting to the App Store.
scope: This source describes how to export a Godot project to an Xcode-compatible format for deployment on iOS devices using Apple's developer tools and standards.
